title: runner: consolidate the duplicated #evaluate expression bridge

raw.title: runner: consolidate the duplicated #evaluate expression bridge
raw.body:
\`StepExecutor\` and \`WorkflowExecutor\` carry near-identical private \`#evaluate\` runtime-expression bridges (lenient \`RuntimeExpressionEvaluator\` construction forwarding \`document\` + \`registry\`); the workflow-side one now takes the document per call (PR #73), the step-side one reads its bound document. Nothing keeps the two in step.

Per the repo convention (shared class logic via a base class or owning abstraction, not util modules), consolidate them — a shared base class or an expression-bridge collaborator both executors take. \`SourceDescriptionsLocatorNormalizer\` (introduced in PR #73 for the two locator normalizers) is the precedent shape.

Part of the pre-1.0 cleanup train feeding the API surface review.
